name: BERSERKER.
body: An unstoppable force of wrath and ruin.

body: A battlefield tactician, leader, and weapon master.

name: MAGE.

body: Inspiring presence, sharp wit, sharper tongue.

body: Master of weather, beast, and nature.

name: ZEPHYR.
body: A disciplined martial artist with swift hands and swift feet.
